evidence.description: Capture filenames, dump filenames, or request ids that back the claim. Relative to the audit repository root.

note.description: Free-text qualifier, used when a claim is true only under conditions.

ordinal.description: Catalog ordinal, `01` through `11`, zero-padded to match capture folders.

input.description: The single typed Text input on the Start trigger.

decisionSignal.description: The uppercase token the agent step is instructed to emit on its final line, for example `ROTATION` or `MERGE_BLOCK`.

flowIdPrefix.description: First eight characters of the flow GUID. Full GUIDs were not exported.

captureFolder.description: Capture folder holding the three per-workflow step stills.

ShowcaseWorkflow.description:
One workflow in the eleven-workflow showcase catalog.

Every entry follows the same three-part shape: a typed text input, an optional connector, an agent that reduces the connector output to a single machine-readable decision line, and a human gate. The decision signal is the load-bearing part. It exists so that a downstream consumer can branch on one grep-able token instead of parsing free prose, and it is the reason each agent's instructions end with a fixed final line.

ConfidenceLevel.description:
How a recorded fact was established.

- `CONFIRMED` - observed directly in the running product: a DOM dump, a   captured network request, or a screenshot showing the resulting state.
- `SOURCE-INSPECTED` - read out of shipped client source (bundle, sourcemap,   or manifest) but never exercised at runtime during the audit.
- `UNCONFIRMED` - inferred from naming, adjacency, or documentation, with no   direct observation behind it.

action.description: The exact action label as it appears in the picker, or null when agent-first.

boundParameter.description: The connector parameter the trigger input is bound to, or null when agent-first.

ShowcaseConnector.description: A first-party connector action bound into a showcase workflow.

ShowcaseConnectorFamily.description:
The connector family bound to a showcase workflow's first action.

`none` is a real, intentional value: three of the eleven workflows are agent-first by design, because their input is a free-text scope rather than a query against an external system. They are not incomplete.
